description: A gross ask that, once converted to a cent-rounded net baseline, lands a hair above the discount cap by float noise alone -- MoneyMath::roundingSlackPercent() (one cent per unit, PR #227) is what keeps this a grant instead of an escalation. The ask is relative to the quote's own unit price (`{unit*f}`), so it ports between products.
openingAsk: {unit*0.85} including tax and we have a deal.
